title: On Cauchy problem and stability of inversion-free feedforward control of piecewise monotonic Krasnoselskii-Pokrovskii hysteresis
summary: We consider the non-homogeneous first-order differential equation with hysteresis described by the Krasnoselskii-Pokrovskii rate-independent hysteresis operator. Existence and uniqueness of solutions as well as the boundedness of solution in response to a bounded input are proved. The global stability of the equation is also investigated. Periodic solutions and their stability are studied in addition.
